Chris McDonald

Agent: David H Headley
Chris McDonald grew up in Northern Ireland before settling in Marple, via Lancaster and London.
He is the author of the ‘DI Erika Piper’ series, as well as the ‘Stonebridge Mysteries’.
Chris also writes under the name Chris Frost, and the first book by this name, The Killer's Christmas List ​ , was published by HarperNorth in 2023.
He is a full-time primary school teacher, husband, father to two beautiful girls and one of the hosts of The Blood Brothers Podcast. He is a fan of 5-a-side football, heavy metal and dogs.

Biography

Chris McDonald MP was appointed Minister of State (Minister for Science, Innovation and Investment) jointly in the Department for Health and Social Care ( DHSC ) on 23 July 2026 and the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade on 21 July 2026.
He was previously Minister for Industry in the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero ( DESNZ ) and the Department for Business and Trade ( DBT ) between 11 September 2025 and 21 July 2026.
He was elected as the MP for Stockton North in July 2024.

Education

Chris studied Chemical Engineering at Cambridge, graduating with BA and MEng degrees. He also completed an MBA at the University of Warwick.

Career outside politics

Before becoming an MP Chris spent 20 years working in the steel industry, with a focus on research.
In 2008, he became a laboratory manager within the research division of Tata Steel. In 2014 he led the divestment of the Materials Processing Institute from Tata Steel UK, becoming CEO .
Chris is also a Fellow at the Royal Academy of Engineering.
